annotations.description: The 7-card hand has 4 lands and 3 castable red spells (Sudden Breakthrough, Welding Sparks, Trove of Temptation). While the hand lacks early creature pressure and has 3 Islands that don't help cast red spells optimally, all spells are castable on curve using the single Mountain. Going to 6 risks a worse hand.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. It has lands, good removal (Welding Sparks), a value engine (Trove of Temptation), and a combat trick (Sudden Breakthrough). The hand curves out and is functional despite being land-heavy.

annotations.description: Bottomed Opt instead of Vodalian Arcanist. With only 6 cards, Opt's card selection and cantrip effect is more valuable than a 1/3 body whose mana ability only works for instants/sorceries - of which none remain in the kept hand after Opt is bottomed.
annotations.betterLine: Bottom Vodalian Arcanist and keep Opt. Opt helps find additional lands and spells when going to 6 cards, while Vodalian Arcanist is a low-impact body with a mana ability that has no targets in the remaining hand.

annotations.description: Vodalian Arcanist is a 1/3 with a narrow mana ability (only for instants/sorceries) that is largely irrelevant against the opponent's Rhonas (5/5 deathtouch indestructible) and growing Benevolent Hydra. Brazen Freebooter provides a much more relevant 3/3 body for blocking plus a Treasure token for mana acceleration, which is critical when facing such threatening creatures.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Vodalian Arcanist (1/3 with narrow mana ability)
annotations.betterLine: Cast Brazen Freebooter to get a 3/3 body that can meaningfully block and a Treasure token for mana flexibility. Could then cast Goldvein Pick with remaining mana next turn or equip it to the Freebooter for value.

annotations.description: Attacking with Goldhound for 1 damage when facing potential lethal next turn from Rhonas (5) + Challenger Troll (6) + Benevolent Hydra (2) = 13 damage, exactly equal to MstLg Critic's life total. Every blocker matters - Goldhound could chump block one attacker to survive. Challenger Troll's ability means power 4+ creatures can only be blocked by one creature each, so additional bodies are valuable.
annotations.betterLine: Keep Goldhound back as an additional blocker. With Vodalian Arcanist, Brazen Freebooter (to be cast postcombat), and Goldhound, you'd have three blockers to handle three potential attackers and survive the swing.

annotations.description: Equipped Goldvein Pick before casting Brazen Freebooter, meaning the Pick goes on Vodalian Arcanist (2/4) or Goldhound (2/2) instead of the 3/3 Freebooter (which would become 4/4 and is much more likely to connect for combat damage and generate treasure tokens).
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Goldvein Pick equip before casting Brazen Freebooter
annotations.betterLine: Cast Brazen Freebooter first (4 mana), then equip Goldvein Pick onto Freebooter (1 mana) to create a 4/4 that generates treasures on combat damage.

annotations.description: Passed priority in postcombat main phase with exactly enough mana to cast Brazen Freebooter (3/3 that creates a Treasure), while facing lethal-level threats from opponent (Rhonas 5/5 deathtouch indestructible, Challenger Troll 6/5). At 13 life, desperately needs blockers and the Treasure token for future plays.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the turn with 4 untapped mana and a castable creature in hand.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Brazen Freebooter for {3}{R} to get a 3/3 blocker and a Treasure token, then potentially equip Goldvein Pick to it or Vodalian Arcanist with remaining resources.

annotations.description: Missed lethal. Savage Punch (with Ferocious active) could kill the only untapped blocker (Vodalian Arcanist 1/3), then attacking with Challenger Troll (6), Rhonas (5), and Benevolent Hydra (2) deals exactly 13 damage to an opponent at 13 life. Instead, Soul's Might was cast on an already indestructible 5/5 deathtouch creature, wasting the turn on overkill stats.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Soul's Might on Rhonas the Indomitable, making it 10/10 (or 11/11 with Hydra bonus)
annotations.betterLine: Cast Savage Punch (2 mana, with Ferocious +2/+2) using any creature with power 4+ to fight and kill Vodalian Arcanist, then attack with Challenger Troll (6) + Rhonas (5) + Benevolent Hydra (2) = 13 damage for exact lethal.

annotations.description: MstLg Critic is at 13 life facing 19 points of incoming combat damage (Rhonas 11 + Challenger Troll 6 + Benevolent Hydra 2). By not blocking, they take lethal damage. Blocking Rhonas the Indomitable with Vodalian Arcanist would prevent 11 damage, reducing incoming to 8, and they'd survive at 5 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Did not block with Vodalian Arcanist, taking 19 lethal damage at 13 life.
annotations.betterLine: Block Rhonas the Indomitable with Vodalian Arcanist to prevent 11 damage, surviving at 5 life instead of dying.
